head: 2f6c549763ea4ee250f30abb72d5f929cc88dabf
scope: Native Finance posting for matched supplier-bill sources: Commerce fulfillment and People expense-claim owner witnesses, clearing-liability debit support, the native Finance API bound to the shared development databases, and a successful desktop UI form posting through the Finance app native client.

implemented.finance: post_supplier_bill_with_evidence accepts PgSupplierBillSource. commerce_fulfillment/expense_claim require a current owner witness whose invoice_id is the posted invoice. commerce_fulfillment may debit the owner goods-received/clearing liability account (control_kind none); standalone/expense claims keep the expense/asset rule.
implemented.locks: Commerce/People source locks precede Commercial authority, Finance and Files.
implemented.native_api: 3198/3199 now use the shared development databases. The shared erpx_migrations checksums for 0041_leave_self_service.sql and 0293_executive_evidence.sql were aligned with the current reviewed files, resolving PRIVATE_API_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.
implemented.native_client: packages/feature-finance/src/adapters/server/native-supplier-bill.ts maps a non-JSON 4xx native reply to that status instead of masking it as 503; debug logging was removed before commit.

gates.format: rustfmt check pass for the changed Rust files

native_http.app_route: POST /api/v1/holdings/acme/finance/payables/<bill>/post returned 200 {status:posted,journalId:...} through the Finance app native client for invoice-3ad23075b3a00bb3940db9974b9cea3540b0, invoice-6ceccfa645c6497774d493dbe99bb98c6b09 and invoice-16e181b67028b0a8c6bc0df3fdc941635296.
native_http.direct_3198: POST the same native route with the finance-approver context returned 200 for invoice-1e204097c33391eec0f31629b4be8aa349e7 (journal-finance-approver-direct-20261110) and invoice-835fa75c19d4385c27a32365712a1d379145 (journal-finance-approver-direct-835-20261110).
native_http.persisted: finance_invoices status=posted, journal source_type=invoice, journal lines debit clearing/payable/input tax as expected.

browser.detail: The Finance invoice detail renders for the seeded finance-approver account after adding its staff person/engagement, finance_approver assignment and flow primary. The Review invoice posting form opened for BILL-F765ECB9707E67DFE9E10936 (invoice-16e181b67028b0a8c6bc0df3fdc941635296), September 2026 was selected, and Approve and post invoice submitted through the app route. The earlier 503 was the retained UI defaulting to period-acme-hospitality-ui-2026-10 while the entry date was 2026-09-15; selecting the matching September period posts successfully. DB readback: status posted, version 2, journal journal-c0e33966-fcf4-4887-8b46-8de168177486, approved_by usr_finance_approver, lines clearing 2150 debit 160000, payable 2100 credit 171200, tax 1400 debit 11200.

dev_data_seeded: company_package_grants acme-co finance/supply/sales active with reviewed grant events.
flow_defaults acme-co invoice finance_approver primary usr_finance_approver.
hr_people/hr_engagements person-acme-finance-approver + finance_approver assignment for usr_finance_approver.
flow_routes draft primary usr_finance_approver for the browser-acceptance bills.
shared Control credential repaired to the native Argon2id hash for the development account; shared erpx_migrations checksums aligned for two reviewed files.
money_transaction_snapshots draft evidence seeded for the draft commerce bills used in the browser/native checks.
remaining: Expense-claim invoice creation when finance_expenses.invoice_id is null is still open; the native post handles an existing draft invoice link only.
Some draft commerce bills still need a flow_routes row (or an eligible primary) before the posting form renders for the finance-approver account.
Finance remains partial at 9/10 workflows and is not owner 6/41.
